title: General ML Debugging
description: General diagnostic workflow for detecting TPU failures, querying crash signatures, mapping physical IDs to GKE instances, and mitigating hardware faults.

step_notes.ai-generate-failure-table: Requires `hw_analysis`, `pod_analysis` and `app_analysis`. Those come from [[ai-hw-analyzer]], [[pod-analyzer]] and [[ai-app-analyzer]] respectively; without them the synthesis step has no inputs and will either fail interpolation or invent the three analyses.
step_notes.job-disruption-timeline: Supplies the restart-attempt timeline that [[ai-app-analyzer]] takes as `timeline_file` / `timeline_json`; without it the analyzer cannot size its per-attempt scan windows. Pass the run window as `start_timestamp` / `end_timestamp`, and treat the attempt list as a noisy draft, as [[workload-disruption-orchestration]] does.
